project_name.description: Project name; supported for project, quote, expense, revenue, payment_schedule, budget_entry.

client_name.description: Customer name; supported for client and the resources supporting project_name.

supplier_name.description: Supplier name; supported only for supplier, quote, expense.

status.description: project: Complété = Complété / Completed, En cours = En cours / In Progress, Pas commencé = Pas commencé / Not Started, En attente = En attente / On Hold, En pause = En pause / Paused, Annulé = Annulé / Cancelled, En attente de démarrage = En attente de démarrage / Waiting to start, Livré = Livré / Delivered; quote: received = Reçu / Received, validated = Validé / Validated, rejected = Refusé / Rejected. No status filter for other resources.

date_from.description: Inclusive ISO start date; only project (start date), quote, expense, revenue, budget_entry (date), payment_schedule (due date).

date_to.description: Inclusive ISO end date; same resources/date fields as date_from.

function.name: get_record
function.description: Retrieve a known record or the authorized current-page record.

function.name: navigate
function.description: Approved native list, record, edit or new-form route. No arbitrary URL.

function.name: knowledge
function.description: Retrieve reviewed permission-aware application procedures and labels.

function.name: clarify
function.description: Ask for missing details, clarify an ambiguous metric, or explain unsupported requests. Choose the current user message language; the backend writes the response.
